AND I WON'T.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 14 ([[The Great Finale]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Left Hand''', internally referred to as '''Hand Boss''', alongside the [[Right Hand]], was the final boss of the [[The Great Finale|third]] act in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health, much higher than any other enemy before it, but it could not enter the base like other enemies and did not take damage the same way as other enemies. As it is a boss enemy, it was immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], could not be frozen by freezing towers and could only be slowed down by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. The '''Left Hand''' had four abilities: #The first ability, ''Temper Fist'', made it move towards a tower, ball up to a fist and smash it, creating a shockwave that stunned any tower. #Its second ability, ''Finger Gun'', made it fire multiple missiles from its index finger at random towers, stunning any tower caught in the explosion. #Its third ability, ''Vanquish'', made it move towards a tower, grab it, squash it and then return to its original position, which killed the tower. It can do this multiple times in a row. #Its last ability, ''Summoning Trickery'', made it dangle its fingers over a path, summoning five enemies, which could be any enemy that appeared before it. ==Appearance== The '''Left Hand''' was a disembodied human hand wearing a white glove. The '''Left Hand''' had a death animation where it would make various hand signals before shrinking into nothing and emitting confetti after it disappeared. ==Strategy== *[[Spotlight]]s are the only reliable way to attack the '''Left Hand''' and [[Right Hand]]. **Both the '''Left Hand''' and [[Right Hand]] cannot be targeted by towers directly, but can still be damaged indirectly from explosions or stray projectiles. **Enemies that spawn around the map have a chance of dropping a single [[Battery]] when killed. These should be collected before Wave 14, as each [[Spotlight]] requires 10 [[Battery|Batteries]] to be used. ***In cases of emergency, it can also be used to confuse enemies coming towards the exit, so that you do not lose due to them. **It is recommended to stay next to the [[Spotlight]] which will have its duration end soon, so that it can be quickly activated again. After this, move to the next [[Spotlight]] which has the lowest amount of time before it deactivates. **The '''Left Hand''' has several abilities where it will quickly move around the map. Players using [[Spotlight]] should retarget them as fast as possible. *The '''Left Hand''' cannot make the player lose by itself. However, enemies that spawn alongside it will if you do not have enough DPS, especially when combined with the '''Left Hand''' and [[Right Hand]]'s abilities. **Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended to deal with them. **Towers like the [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against them when there are multiple of them placed down. **The [[Medic]] is a reliable tower to cleanse stuns. *Do note that the '''Left Hand''' can kill your towers. **It is advised to have bait towers, however it is not a requirement since the only way to kill the '''Left Hand''' is by using the [[Spotlight]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Loss |- |[[File:HandBossAct3Laugh.oga]] |Plays upon losing |} }} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CrazyHandFloat.gif|Floating animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandPunch.gif|''Temper Fist'' animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandGun.gif|''Finger Gun'' animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandKill.gif|''Vanquish'' animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandSummon.gif|''Summoning Trickery'' animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandRun.gif|''Summoning Trickery'' animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandDeath.gif|Death animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandStun.gif|Stun animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) CrazyHandStunRecover.gif|Stun Recovery animation (12 November 2023 – 21 December 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} ActIIIUpdateIcon.png|'''Left Hand''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Act 3 Cutscene 3-4 - Scrapped - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Left Hand''' in the scrapped opening [[The Great Finale]] cutscene. Night 2 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Left Hand''' in the [[Banlands]] cutscenes. Night 3 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Left Hand''' in the [[Blind Faith]] cutscenes. "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Left Hand''' in the [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Stickers}} ClappingRightyAndLeftySticker.png|'''Left Hand''' on the [[Clapping Righty and Lefty]] sticker }} ==Trivia== *The '''Left Hand''' was given to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] as a gift from [[Lord Exo]]. Its name is ''Lefty''. *The '''Left Hand''' was most likely inspired by the [https://www.ssbwiki.com/Crazy_Hand Crazy Hand] from ''Super Smash Bros''. **The fact that the '''Left Hand''' has 300,000 health could also be a reference to the [https://www.ssbwiki.com/Crazy_Hand Crazy Hand] having 300 health in ''Super Smash Bros''. *After losing to the '''Left Hand''' and [[Right Hand]], a laugh could be heard. *This along with the [[Right Hand]] are the second bosses to have the ability to kill towers, with the first being the [[Raider Boss]]. *The '''Left Hand''' spawned slightly before the [[Right Hand]]. *When summoning enemies, the enemies were called "''Hand Boss's _____''" instead of "''Left Hand's _____''". *The '''Left Hand''' would indirectly return as an [[Enemy|enemy]] in [[The Narratorium]] as part of the [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]. ==Update History== *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **'''Left Hand''' added. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Left Hand''' removed. {{TheGreatFinale|[[Actor3 (Lunar Overture)|Actor3]]|Wave 12|Left Hand & [[Right Hand]]|Wave 14|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
